overall_goal: Unpack tupperware, make space in the fridge, heat rice, and stir the curry

goals.description: Stir the curry in the pot
goals.rationale: The person picks up a fork, walks to the pot, and stirs the curry and basil leaves.

goals.description: Extract tupperware and items from the lunch bag
goals.rationale: The person opens the lunch bag and removes tupperware, covers, and napkins, placing them on the countertop.

goals.description: Test tupperware covers and store items away
goals.rationale: The person tests if the covers fit the tupperware, closes them, and puts away the lunch bag and a cup.

goals.description: Make space in the fridge for the tupperware
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge and rearranges items like cheese and yogurt to create room.

goals.description: Inspect the tupperware under the kitchen lights
goals.rationale: The person picks up the tupperware, pries it open, and turns on the lights to inspect its contents.

goals.description: Stir the pot and wipe hands
goals.rationale: The person stirs the pot again with a fork, then wipes their hands on a kitchen rag and adjusts the pot.

goals.description: Retrieve a pack of microwavable rice from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person opens the cabinet, moves items around, and selects a pack of microwavable rice.

goals.description: Heat the rice in the microwave
goals.rationale: The person tears open the rice pouch, places it in the microwave, and turns it on.

goals.description: Retrieve a plate from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person lifts items in the cabinet to extract a plate and places it on the counter.

goals.description: Search for a serving spoon in the first two cabinets
goals.rationale: The person rummages through multiple drawers and cabinets, lifting various utensils in search of a serving spoon.

goals.description: Continue searching for a serving spoon in another cabinet
goals.rationale: The person opens another cabinet and looks under items like a rolling pin and can opener to find a serving spoon.

goals.description: Stir the curry and add basil leaves
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the pot with a fork and plucks more basil leaves to add to the curry.

goals.description: Retrieve and serve the microwaved rice
goals.rationale: The person opens the microwave, takes out the heated rice pouch, and pours it onto a plate.
